span.normalized: The creditworthiness of customers and other counterparties is subject to continuing review, including the use of master netting agreements, where appropriate. During 2025, sales to EGPC in Egypt accounted for approximately 15 percent of the Company’s worldwide crude oil, natural gas, and NGLs revenues. During 2024 and 2023, sales to EGPC accounted for approximately 17 percent and 15 percent, respectively, of the Company’s worldwide crude oil, natural gas, and NGLs revenues.
